Frequently asked questions

How to use the Anime Profile Picture on Discord

Want to use the "Anime" profile picture on Discord ? Follow these simple steps:

  1. Open Discord and click the Settings gear next to your name
  2. Navigate to the User Profile tab
  3. Click Change Avatar
  4. Upload the image you downloaded from Pfps.gg
  5. Click Apply to save your new avatar

Thats it! Your new profile picture, Anime , is now active on Discord.

How to use the Anime Profile Picture on Instagram

Want to use the "Anime" PFP on Instagram ? Heres how to do it:

  1. Download the image from Pfps.gg to your phone or computer
  2. Open the Instagram app or visit instagram.com
  3. Go to your profile and tap Edit Profile
  4. Select Change Profile Photo
  5. Choose New Profile Photo and upload the downloaded image
  6. Adjust and crop if necessary, then tap Done

Thats it! You have successfully set Anime as your Instagram profile picture.
